svg.title: AGV battery sizing – energy per shift and state of charge with opportunity charging (example)
svg.text: Battery sizing – energy per 8 h shift and state of charge over two shifts (U300 crate AGV, P1000 pallet AGV)
LiFePO4 16s 51.2 V. U300 60 Ah = 3072 Wh, 168 W average (8 transports/h). P1000 105 Ah = 5376 Wh, 281 W average (8.6 crankcases/h, §22.2).
Energy per 8 h shift (Wh) vs usable battery energy
usable 2458 Wh (80 %)
usable 4301 Wh (80 %)
driving: rolling
driving: accelerating
lift
deck chains (P1000)
electronics + idle (150 / 200 W)
→ the electronics (PC, scanners, drives on standby) use 75–90 % of the energy, not the driving.
Ask the supplier for the STANDBY power – it decides the battery size.
State of charge over 16 h (two shifts)
time (h)
go to charger at 25 %
U300 no charging: 25 % after 13.7 h
U300 6 min/h on contacts: 84 % after 16 h
P1000 no charging: 25 % after 14.3 h
P1000 10 min/h at LOAD-CC: 85 % after 16 h
Without charging: U300 reaches 25 % after 13.7 h, P1000 after 14.3 h (new battery).
Opportunity charging (1.5 kW · 0.92 = 1380 W) for a few minutes per hour keeps the
SOC high: U300 needs 7.3 min/h, P1000 12.2 min/h for full balance.
Charge to 100 % once a day so the BMS resets SOC and balances the cells.
Sizing formula (guide §22.3) – verified with Python
Capacity C [Ah] = E_shift / (U_nom · DoD · SOH_end) DoD = usable depth of discharge, SOH_end = capacity left at end of life
U300, 8 h without charging: 1344 / (51.2 · 0.8) = 32.8 Ah → with SOH_end 0.8: 41.0 Ah (16 h: 82.0 Ah)
P1000, 8 h without charging: 2250 / (51.2 · 0.8) = 54.9 Ah → with SOH_end 0.8: 68.7 Ah (16 h: 137 Ah)
Chosen: U300 60 Ah + opportunity charging (runtime 14.6 h new / 11.7 h at end of life);
P1000 105 Ah + opportunity charging (15.3 h new / 12.2 h at end of life at 281 W).
C-rate I / C: U300 peak 14.3 A / 60 Ah = 0.24 C · P1000 lift 26 A / 105 Ah = 0.25 C · charge 27 A = 0.45 C / 0.26 C
Cycles P1000 281 W · 16 h / 5376 Wh = 0.84 full cycles per day → ≈ 280 per year → 3000-cycle LFP ≈ 10 years
Lead-acid alternative 51.2 V 105 Ah ≈ 180 kg (30 Wh/kg) vs LFP ≈ 48 kg – and lead does not like opportunity charging.
EXAMPLE – check the maker's documentation
